TALOS = Talent Acquisition Leveraged Operating System

TALOS stands for Talent Acquisition Leveraged Operating System. TALOS Social brings your recruiting expertise, employer brand, content planning, and approval process into one configurable workspace. Start solo or invite a team. You decide who has access and who can publish.

Account management

Change my password

Publishing connector

Mock mode runs a safe simulated publishing test. Make mode requires a new dedicated webhook and callback integration. Never paste your original approval webhook here.

Publishing dispatch history

Track simulated or Make delivery attempts and callback outcomes. A queued post does not mean it has been published.

Live Make setup

  1. Create a dedicated Make scenario and webhook for TALOS Social. Do not reuse your existing Transmit approval webhook.
  2. Configure a separate LinkedIn test connection in Make.
  3. Have Make send the publishing result to /api/integrations/make/callback using the private callback secret in the X-Talos-Secret header.
  4. Test with mock mode first, then verify a real test-account post and its returned LinkedIn URN.

See docs/LIVE_INTEGRATION_RUNBOOK.md for the full payload and security guidance.

Content missions

Monday: Hiring intelligence · Tuesday: Recruiting opportunities · Wednesday: Professional authority · Thursday: Employer branding · Friday: Cybersecurity and identity insights.

These missions are adapted from the uploaded Authority Engine. Customer brand voice and verified company facts must be configured separately; AI generation is not yet wired into this interface.

Recruiter guide

1. Create a draft in Content Studio. 2. Submit it for review. 3. A separate reviewer approves or rejects it. 4. An admin queues an approved post. 5. Until an authorized publishing connector is configured, publish manually.

Reviewer guide

Review accuracy, tone, candidate privacy, company policies, links and duplication before approval. Reject with actionable feedback. A different team member must approve the author's draft.

Approval and regeneration

Approved posts can be queued for dispatch by an administrator. Rejected posts return to the draft workflow with reviewer feedback. The original Make Approval Handler can generate a new version, but automatic regeneration from this interface is not yet connected.

Admin guide

Customize organization identity, create team accounts and assign roles. Configure server secrets outside the browser. Review audit records through /api/audit. See bundled docs for Make mapping, deployment, security and commercial rollout.
